# DELETE /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}

Delete a repository

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-370`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |

## Response

**204** — empty

- **403** — User is not owner or org admin
- **404** — Repository not found

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | repo.Delete | controller | Check CanUserDelete; Close git repo; Call DeleteRepository service |
| 2 | [modules](../modules/modules.md) | repo_module.CanUserDelete | utility | Check if user is admin or owner; Check if user is org admin |
| 3 | [services](../modules/services.md) | repo_service.DeleteRepository | service | Delete all repo data from DB; Remove git repo from disk; Remove LFS objects; Notify watchers |
